stem: Priya's science teacher in her Delhi school explains what happens after most nutrients are digested and absorbed in the small intestine. What happens to the remaining undigested food?

options.text: It moves back into the stomach to be digested again.
It moves into the large intestine.
It passes through the small intestine wall into the blood.
It stays in the small intestine until it is fully digested.

teacher.key_rationale: After digestion and absorption of most nutrients in the small intestine, the remaining undigested food passes into the large intestine, where water is absorbed before egestion. Options A, C and D contradict the one-way flow of the alimentary canal and the fact that undigested material cannot be absorbed into the blood or fully digested in the small intestine.
